question: After worshipping the lord of vastu well, in what posture should one be seated facing north?
premises: The lord of vastu is worshipped well.
One is seated on own seat.
inference: Having worshipped the lord of vastu well, one should be seated on one’s own seat facing north.
uncertainties: Who performs this is implied as the practitioner.
plain_english: Having worshipped the lord of vastu well, seated on one’s own seat, facing north.
